build.beforeDevCommand: sh -c 'if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then exec pnpm --dir ui dev; elif [ -f package.json ]; then exec pnpm dev; elif [ -f ../ui/package.json ]; then exec pnpm --dir ../ui dev; fi'
build.beforeBuildCommand: sh -c 'if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then exec pnpm --dir ui build; elif [ -f package.json ]; then exec pnpm build; elif [ -f ../ui/package.json ]; then exec pnpm --dir ../ui build; fi'

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost
